# نُسْتَأْجَرُ (nustaʔjaru) /nus.taʔ.d͡ʒa.ru/: first-person plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَأْجَرَ (istaʔjara)
# نَسْتَأْجِرَ (nastaʔjira) /nas.taʔ.d͡ʒi.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَأْجَرَ (istaʔjara)
